identity.statusNote: Canva Pro is a paid tier of the Canva product, not a separately branded standalone tool.

sources.title: Third-party summary of Canva pricing (direct fetch of canva.com/pricing/ was blocked, HTTP 403)

limits.en: Free Canva plan available with limited templates and no Magic Studio AI feature access; Canva Pro is the upgraded paid tier.

keyLimits.en: $18/month billed monthly, or $144/year (≈$12/month) billed annually. Full access to Magic Studio AI tools, premium templates, brand kit, background remover and automatic resizing.

cautions.en: The official canva.com/pricing/ page returned HTTP 403 when fetched directly in this session; the price figures come from independent pricing-tracker sites rather than Canva's own page, and should be re-verified against the official source before publication.

capabilities.en: Full access to Magic Studio AI features (image generation, background removal, Magic Write) beyond what the free Canva plan offers.
Brand kit for storing brand colors, fonts and logos consistently across designs.
Premium template and stock asset library not available on the free plan.
Automatic resizing (Magic Resize) to adapt a single design across multiple formats and platforms.

limitations.en: Pricing could not be independently confirmed on Canva's own official pricing page in this session (blocked, HTTP 403), only via third-party trackers.
Canva Pro is single-user; multi-user teams need the separate, more expensive Canva Teams plan for shared brand controls and approval workflows.

unknowns: Official canva.com/pricing/ page blocked direct fetch (HTTP 403) in this session; the $18/month and $144/year figures are taken from independent pricing-tracker sites, not Canva's own page, and need re-verification.
Canva Teams price not confirmed in this session.
conflicts: The seed's shortDescription for canva-pro (an entry in the design-tools/creation catalogue) describes it as the paid tier of Canva rather than a fully separate tool; alternativeCandidates provided in the seed largely list unrelated creative tools rather than direct Canva-tier competitors, so no in-catalogue alternatives were selected.
